data.case_title: Childcare place offer for Jonas (Kita-Verbund Beispielkinder)
data.explanation: The childcare provider (Kita-Verbund Beispielkinder) is offering your son Jonas a nursery place starting 1 February 2027. You need to reply accepting or declining the offer within the deadline shown in the app, counted only on weekdays from the letter's date. If you don't reply in time, the place goes to the next family on the waiting list, so don't delay. No form is specified — you can likely just call or email the provider using the contact details on the letter. No payment is requested at this stage.
